hook: Virus-like particles deliver CRISPR and Cre tools into pig and chicken cells, organoids, eggs
hook_turn: into pig and chicken cells, organoids, eggs
summary: Virus-like particles carried gene-editing proteins into pig cells, organoids and oocytes, and into chicken cells, tracheal cultures and eggs, with high editing rates. This sidesteps a common delivery problem for livestock genetics. The work is in cultures and early embryos, and no edited animals are reported.
title: Virus-like particles enable highly efficient gene editing across porcine and avian in vitro, ex vivo, and in ovo models.
